title: Obscure API webhook failure in enterprise plan
description: Our enterprise workspace stopped receiving order.updated webhooks after yesterday's dashboard change. HMAC signatures fail validation intermittently. No public docs mention this. We need an engineer, not a FAQ, within 24 hours or our integration stays down.

title: Mixed praise and serious access failure
description: Most of the clinical staff are excellent and I have been with the practice 30 years. But for the last year it has been impossible to get an appointment if you work. Phone queues at 8am fail, the app has no e-consult, and I went without antidepressants for five days. I am leaving a complaint as much as praise.

title: Child ear infection results delayed two weeks
description: My 6 year old has severe ear infection with discharge. You took swabs and it has been two weeks with no results and no antibiotics. Reception keeps saying wait. This is not acceptable for a child in pain. I want clinical follow-up today and an explanation of the delay.
